title: SF424 Mandatory Form
description: SF424 Mandatory Form (SF424_Mandatory_3_0) is a streamlined variant of the SF-424 used for formula grants, block grants, and other mandatory awards. Unlike the standard SF-424, it includes submission type, frequency, version, and consolidated request fields, but has a reduced estimated funding section (Federal and Match only, versus 7 line items on the standard SF-424).
notes: Organization optionality: The XSD marks the Organization element as optional (minOccurs="0"), but the DAT marks Legal Name, EIN/TIN, and UEI as required. Resolution: follow the XSD. Organization is optional at the XML level; when present, its sub-fields (OrgName, SAMUEI) are required within the complex type. Enforce required sub-fields at the UI level only when the organization section is shown.

EIN/TIN placement: The DAT shows EIN/TIN as a separate field (07b-1) outside the organization address, but in the XSD it is nested inside OrganizationDataTypeV4. Resolution: follow the XSD nesting. The UI can display it as a separate field while mapping to the correct XML path.

State requirement: DAT says State is "required if Country is the United States" but the XSD marks State as optional (minOccurs="0" within AddressDataTypeV3). Resolution: follow the XSD for XML validation; enforce the conditional rule at the UI level.

ZIP/Postal Code requirement: DAT says ZIP is "required if the country is the United States" with minimum 9 characters for US addresses. The XSD marks ZipPostalCode as optional (minOccurs="0"). Resolution: follow the XSD for XML validation; enforce the US-specific rule at the UI level.

Contact Title optionality: DAT marks Contact Title (07f-07) as optional, which matches the XSD (minOccurs="0"). However, AOR Title (18-05) is marked required in both DAT and XSD (minOccurs=1). No conflict here, just notable.
DepartmentNameDataType V1: This form uses the V1 type (maxLength 30), not V2 (maxLength 100). Verify the correct maxLength is applied.
DivisionNameDataType V1: Same as above: V1 (maxLength 30), not V2 (maxLength 100).
SAMUEIDataType: Exact length 12 (minLength 12, maxLength 12). Enforce as exact-length validation, not range.

OrganizationDataTypeV4 nesting: Organization bundles OrgName, SAMUEI, DeptName, DivName, Address, and EIN into a single complex type. The JSON model flattens some of these for UI convenience. Ensure the XML serializer correctly nests them.
State/Province xs:choice: In AddressDataTypeV3, State and Province are in an xs:choice, meaning only one can appear in valid XML. The UI should toggle between them based on Country selection.
Attachment group: The attachments element uses AttachmentGroupMin0Max100DataType, allowing 0-100 files. Unlike single AttachedFileDataType fields, this is a multi-attachment container.
risks: The Organization element is optional in the XSD, but for practical purposes, most agencies will require it. The UI should treat it as a required section and flag if left empty.
Department and Division use V1 types (maxLength 30), which is shorter than the V2 types (maxLength 100) used in the R&R SF-424. Users with long department/division names may need to abbreviate.
The Mandatory form has only 2 estimated funding lines (Federal and Match), unlike the standard SF-424's 7 lines. Agencies that need more granular funding breakdowns should use the standard SF-424.

The "Version" field (Initial/Resubmission/Revision/Update) is distinct from the "Application Type" concept in other SF-424 variants. Ensure the UI labels and help text clearly distinguish these concepts for users who work with multiple SF-424 variants.
